data.content_ref: inline:The 'Variance Floor' mechanism in 00321f6b7b18 integrates with the 'Algorithmic Floor' effect in 051b3183aa966e6232f1e635aa7259bf92ad1c5ad996954879f69a27783391d3, as both describe the conversion of high-variance intuitive processes into low-variance deterministic processes to eliminate catastrophic failure; this relation is refuted if the 'Variance Floor' is shown to be a psychological phenomenon of the panel members rather than a structural property of the checklist itself.
